keyword: has there ever been a tie at the oscars
claims: There was a tie for Best Live Action Short Film at the 98th Academy Awards in March 2026 between Two People Exchanging Saliva and The Singers.
There was a tie for Best Sound Editing at the 85th Academy Awards in 2013 between Skyfall and Zero Dark Thirty.
There was a tie for Best Live Action Short Film at the 67th Academy Awards in 1995 between Franz Kafka's It's a Wonderful Life and Trevor.
There was a tie for Best Documentary Feature at the 59th Academy Awards in 1987 between Artie Shaw: Time Is All You've Got and Down and Out in America.
There was a tie for Best Actress at the 41st Academy Awards in 1969 between Katharine Hepburn in The Lion in Winter and Barbra Streisand in Funny Girl.
There was a tie for Best Documentary Short at the 22nd Academy Awards in 1950 between A Chance to Live and So Much for So Little.
There was a tie for Best Actor at the 5th Academy Awards in 1932 between Fredric March and Wallace Beery.
Rules at the time of the 5th Academy Awards allowed a tie if votes were within a 3-vote margin.
Ties have occurred roughly 6-7 times across various categories in Oscars history.
